items.prompt: A level report says bid 100 quantity 8. What can it NOT determine by itself?

options.text: The aggregate resting quantity 8 at that side/price.
options.why: That is exactly the quantity the report contains.

options.text: Which bid price label the aggregate belongs to.
options.why: The label 100 is explicitly part of the report.

options.text: That there is positive aggregate quantity at that bid level.
options.why: Eight is a positive level total under the model.

options.text: The FIFO arrival order of individual orders making up those 8 units.
options.why: A side/price sum loses per-order identities and arrival positions.

items.explanation: A side/price sum loses per-order identities and arrival positions.
